findings.conclusion: Original response bytes are strictly checked for complete single JSON value, Unicode and recursively unique decoded property names before UseNumber. No JCS canonicalization precedes schema. Bytes(json.Number) preserves its number lexeme; schema roundtrip again uses UseNumber. Pinned v6.0.3 uses big.Rat integer and numeric bounds, then domain.Num requires exact signed int64. Fractional near-integer lexemes are not rounded into accepted integers.

Configuration head still requires current < 9007199254740991. Scoped Session expected revision equal to that maximum is admitted; exact response revision current+1=9007199254740992 is consumed and persisted as int64, sent epoch retained. Real-Host test injects only counters and explicitly labels INJECTED; this is boundary behavior, not proof of quadrillions of real handoffs.

The table currently asserts exit1, 2 requests and unchanged local bytes but not this exact reason, so runtime evidence must distinguish intentional non-completion from earlier malformed-schema rejection.
